items.expected: For each intact neutral H, Me and OMe dimer, actual matched physical singlet/triplet calculations establish a lower coupled singlet and antiferromagnetic molecular exchange. Report the three J values with units under J=E(S)-E(T), or transparently convert another convention, and establish the physical spin-state identity. The values are evidence for the common exchange character, not three author-value targets. A broken-symmetry label or formal Cu(II) count without state evidence does not establish this result.

Use matched full-molecule spin-state energies to quantify the Me minus H exchange difference and determine whether it is resolved relative to demonstrated numerical, state and relevant structural/model uncertainty. The source-like result is a small negative difference, indicating stronger antiferromagnetic exchange. A bounded conclusion that this small effect is not resolved also passes when actual comparable calculations and a justified uncertainty analysis establish that finding; convergence failure, omitted work or an unsupported uncertainty assertion do not. Report the signed result actually obtained and delimit its model scope. Do not mix methods between members, infer a difference from overlapping absolute-value windows, substitute material-fit ordering, or claim that conditional solver residuals bound total method error.

items.statement: Electronic explanation of the molecular substitution dependence
items.expected: Use actual spin-resolved orbitals, spin correlations or equivalent many-electron evidence to explain how the axial ligand is associated with exchange through coupled Cu-centered open-shell degrees of freedom. Connect ligand/core electronic structure with the computed substitution response or its demonstrated lack of resolution; distinguish a molecular electronic association from a Hamiltonian factor, root switch or composition change. The source associates more electron-rich axial pyridines with modestly stronger exchange. A supported bounded or physically equivalent explanation passes; a unique separation of geometry and electronics, fixed NTO weights or a particular analysis tool is not required. Repeating exchange values, formal oxidation labels or unsupported causal speculation fails.
